page_title: DOR 4-0 MAI | Dortmund v Mainz 13/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Tobias Welz has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+2' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Gregor Kobel, who smothers the ball.
90+1' Fabio Silva (Dortmund) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
89' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

88' Nelson Weiper (Mainz) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball low towards the middle of the goal. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Gregor Kobel with a fabulous save.
86' Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
86' 7:1 – the corner kicks stats.
84' 4 - 0 It's a goal! Lovely finish directed into the back of the net by Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund).
83' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
83' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
83' Jobe Bellingham (Dortmund) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play. Dortmund will have a chance to score from a corner.
82' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
81' A pass by Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
80' Fabio Silva (Dortmund) receives the ball inside the box from the resulting free kick, but fails to score as his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
79' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) takes a direct free kick.
79' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) switches the play to Fabio Silva and their attacking move continues.
77' Mainz take a short corner kick.

76' Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Gregor Kobel anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the bottom left corner. Mainz force a corner. They send men into the box.
74' We are about to witness a substitution. Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) is replacing Serhou Guirassy.
74' The substitution is prepared. Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Felix Nmecha.
73' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
73' Here is a change. Phillip Tietz is going off and Urs Fischer gives the last tactical orders to Nelson Weiper (Mainz).
71' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
69' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
68' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) takes the corner.
66' Luca Reggiani (Dortmund) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
64' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
61' The substitution has been made. Fabio Silva (Dortmund) has replaced Maximilian Beier.
61' Here comes a substitution. Maximilian Beier is given a rest as he is replaced by Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund).
61' Silvan Widmer will be replaced by Phillipp Mwene (Mainz).
60' Urs Fischer prepares a substitution. Jae-Sung Lee is replaced by Paul Nebel (Mainz).
60' That's the end of the game for Silas, who is replaced by Sheraldo Becker (Mainz).
60' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) watches the corner all the way, but places his header a whisker wide of the left post from close range.
59' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) steps up to send the ball in.
59' Dortmund move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession. Dortmund win a corner.
57' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Daniel Batz has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
56' Stefan Posch (Mainz) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
55' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) hits an explosive shot from outside the penalty area and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.

52' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Daniel Batz guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.

51' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the right post is, however, superbly saved by Gregor Kobel!
51' A cross into the box from Danny da Costa (Mainz) is cleared.
49' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
49' The ball has crossed the sideline. Mainz are taking a throw-in.
47' Dortmund players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
46' Niko Kovac makes a switch. Luca Reggiani is coming on in place of Niklas Sule (Dortmund) at the start of the second period.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
45+3' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
45+2' Dangerous play by Julian Ryerson (Dortmund). Tobias Welz blows his whistle for a foul. Mainz are awarded a free kick.
45+2' Dortmund hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
44' Kaishu Sano (Mainz) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.

42' 3 - 0 Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the top left corner. The goalkeeper had no chance to react. The score is now 3:0.
42' The referee awards a corner and Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) goes over to take it.
41' The resulting corner from Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
40' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Dortmund are awarded a corner kick.
40' Silas (Mainz) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
38' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Phillip Tietz (Mainz) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
36' A spell of possession for Mainz in an attempt to control the game.
34' Wasted effort! Niklas Sule (Dortmund) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range.
34' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
32' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) swings in a cross from the corner, but Daniel Batz reads it well and gathers the ball.
29' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) attempts to release Serhou Guirassy with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
28' Jobe Bellingham (Dortmund) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.
27' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kacper Potulski (Mainz) is coming onto the pitch as Stefan Bell cannot continue after picking up an injury.
26' Stefan Bell (Mainz) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
26' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
24' Stefan Bell (Mainz) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
23' Niklas Sule (Dortmund) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

21' Silas (Mainz) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
20' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

19' Dortmund are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
16' A player from Mainz commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.

15' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) makes it 2:0. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Julian Ryerson and planted his close-range header into the bottom left corner. Daniel Batz was helpless.
14' A crossfield pass from Dominik Kohr (Mainz) fails to find any of his teammates.
12' Tobias Welz blows his whistle and it's Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

10' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Julian Ryerson flights the free kick into the box, where Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) peels off his marker and heads straight into the left side of the net from the edge of the six-yard box. He makes it 1:0.
9' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
7' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
5' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
3' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
1' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot goalwards, but the keeper produces a decent save!
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Mainz will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Tobias Welz.
